findings.summary: Marketplace discovery reads platform-wide sitemaps, so Pinkoi, Shopee, and MyShip sources can admit another seller's products.
findings.fix: Restrict sitemap discovery to official sources and keep marketplace discovery provenance-bound to its supplied listing.

findings.summary: All platforms use the generic all-anchor parser; the required seven specialized catalog parsers and scoped fixture coverage are absent.
findings.fix: Add platform-specific selectors/extractor IDs with generic fallback only for the remaining platforms.

findings.summary: Stored and scraped candidates are admitted by hostname, which is insufficient for shared marketplace hosts.
findings.fix: Require exact catalog-owned URL membership for shared marketplace channels.

findings.summary: Rendered recoveries remain counted dead and inspectable static no-catalog pages can be mislabeled render_blocked.
findings.fix: Track final route reachability and only classify an empty/app-shell surface as render blocked.

findings.summary: Catalog detail pages are hydrated sequentially in a loop, violating the project's batch-over-N+1 rule.
findings.fix: Hydrate a bounded selected batch concurrently while preserving the global 25-page cap and source order.

findings.summary: renderMode reports renderer availability rather than whether rendering was actually used.
findings.fix: Instrument render-provider invocation and report the observed mode.

findings.summary: Classifier keep subtracts rejections from a later hero-image pass and can undercount kept classifier results.
findings.fix: Count classifier keep dispositions directly from classifier output.

findings.summary: Proposal yield divides by the truncated ranked list instead of all candidates that survived the product gate.
findings.fix: Use the full gate-survivor count as denominator.

findings.summary: The evaluator duplicates production batch/model/pHash behavior and bypasses audited OpenAI and search adapters.
findings.fix: Reuse production classifier profile, duplicate predicate, and audited search/LLM boundaries.

findings.summary: Missing cohort brands are silently omitted, allowing incomplete five-brand reports.
findings.fix: Fail evaluation with the missing requested slugs.

findings.summary: Fingerprint fallback bypasses MyShip's path guard on native MyShip non-product pages.
findings.fix: Allow fingerprint fallback only for custom domains not identified from the URL.

findings.summary: Scoped adapters drop relative image URLs and generic gallery fallback can reintroduce excluded chrome.
findings.fix: Resolve against the page URL and allow specialized adapters to disable generic fallback.

findings.summary: Required regressions for evidence reuse, partial failures, breadth order, zero reasons, fingerprints, and same-marketplace cross-store rejection are missing.
findings.fix: Add observable pure/service tests at HTTP/render/LLM boundaries.

findings.summary: A new image test only asserts that a rejection-code constant remains unchanged, which project test rules explicitly forbid.
findings.fix: Replace it with observable gate-output assertions.

findings.summary: New unused exports, labels, and a test-only implicit render factory add unsupported extension points.
findings.fix: Remove unused additions and vacuous tests.

findings.summary: Unrelated union formatting in curation-operations increases conflict risk with staging.
findings.fix: Restore unrelated formatting.

findings.summary: Deduplication shortens the image-download result array although callers require one positional result per input.
findings.fix: Expand unique results back to input positions and return null for duplicate positions.

findings.summary: dHash processing failures escape the gate and are mislabeled fetch_failed.
findings.fix: Map local image-processing failures to process_failed.

findings.summary: Relative sitemap URLs are not resolved and a depth-limited sitemap index can be mistaken for product URLs.
findings.fix: Resolve locations and never emit sitemap-index locations as products.

findings.summary: Per-source positions are reused globally, so later marketplace candidates can interleave ahead of official results.
findings.fix: Assign catalog candidate order from adaptive discovery output order.

findings.summary: Per-method counts include repeated URLs instead of unique adapter images.
findings.fix: Count unique URL-method pairs.

findings.summary: Baseline/post-change cohorts, staging Clany, production migration/pilot, approval, and public checks require external environments and explicit rollout authority.
findings.fix: Run the documented staged verification after local review; do not publish if thresholds fail.

findings.summary: A failed first upload can leave a concurrently claimed perceptual hash rejecting another viable duplicate candidate.
findings.fix: Future work: introduce a two-stage or waitable reservation pipeline; this is broader than the current scoped implementation.

findings.summary: Production implicitly creates Playwright through getRenderProvider.
findings.evidence: No production caller imports the helper; only tests do.

findings.summary: Any CDN image is accepted for an owned URL.
findings.evidence: The products phase checks exact normalized candidate membership and exact candidate-bound image evidence.
